scope: Common numerical and reporting contract for four PRICE cap/base arms. Preserve historical run receipts and evaluation outcomes.

projector.breakpoints: Retain numeric value, owning block and endpoint kind ZERO=n/w or CAP=(n-cap)/w. A set of scalar values alone loses the necessary identity.
projector.selected_endpoint: Materialize exact zero/cap for blocks whose endpoint is selected, including all tied endpoint owners. Preserve the minimum-tau convention and exact interior affine root.
projector.interior: Do not delete mathematically positive interior blocks based on a new norm threshold. Check root-endpoint equality against tagged knots before reconstructing vectors.
projector.near_endpoint: If an implementation needs a near-endpoint rule beyond exact tagged equality, predeclare a small FP64 ULP bound and its reference operands. Record each applied correction and reject it if existing KKT or feasibility checks fail. A broad norm cutoff or enlarged KKT tolerance is not this repair.
projector.storage: Construct exact-zero vectors explicitly in FP32 for zero-classified lengths. Report fp64 endpoint class, stored norm, correction mask and correction magnitude. Keep moment state and task-gradient reentry.

checks.free_mode: No local cap, local excess or capped mask assertion. Serialize null local caps with an explicit mode; do not send infinity into finite-domain checks. Retain all finite-input, nonnegative-length and dual checks.

not_allowed: hidden local clip in free arms

optimizer_implication.norm_gradient: (0.5/a_star^2)*R/||R|| for any nonzero block; selected zero subgradient only for exact zero
optimizer_implication.trajectory: An endpoint repair can change gradients, moments, gamma and later R even when its immediate write is tiny. All comparison arms require the same corrected implementation and a corrected cold CAP075 reference.
optimizer_implication.historical_evaluation: Existing measured RS/PS/NS remain evidence for the source that produced them. Telemetry-only reaggregation cannot claim the performance of the corrected optimizer.

telemetry.version: New explicit schema revision shared by producer, collector and publication reducer

diagnostic_threshold.usage: Posthoc/reporting partition only; not a projection or gradient threshold

telemetry.ratios: Retain raw mathematically defined ratios and label their domain. Report above-diagnostic-threshold conditional summaries separately with ratio_defined/reason, threshold, selected count and total count. Exceeding the threshold does not guarantee a reliable ratio. Do not silently replace raw ratios or describe conditional means as all-owner realization.
telemetry.support: Report mathematical FP64 zero classification, exact stored zero count, positive tiny diagnostic count and above-threshold count separately. Add zero-to-positive reentry; never equate an owner's zero R with zero actual action.
telemetry.leakage: Preserve observed cross-owner action on zero/tiny target blocks as actual_norm/anchor with its target class. Never zero the numerator to clean a ratio.
telemetry.units: Distinguish layer-owner, canonical-row, mean-key and owner-mean-context reductions. Existing rewrite/KL summaries are owner means. Report metric-specific valid counts; cosine additionally needs nonzero action.
telemetry.sufficient_statistics_future: For each owner and role save row count and sums of action squared norm, target squared norm, dot(action,target) and squared residual. Use float64 reductions from existing evaluated tensors; no additional model pass.
telemetry.energy_ratio: sqrt(sum action_squared_norm / sum target_squared_norm) only when the complete selected-population denominator is positive; name the population and retain leakage diagnostics.
telemetry.historical_limit: Do not square an owner-mean context norm and call it a context squared-norm sum. Mark missing sufficient statistics NOT_RECORDED. Canonical/mean-key scalar norms support their own energy aggregation, not arbitrary context aggregation.

price: raw_kappa and effective_pi distributions by batch/layer
controller: F and rewrite NLL and weighted KL
publication.cap: Separate base-stage cap contacts from expanded-stage contacts. Base=.75 and pi>=1 makes local .75 caps redundant; contact is not an independent causal bottleneck.
publication.aggregation: Bind every table to source/config, completed batch prefix, input manifest and reducer SHA. Document per-request share means versus pooled energy shares. Preserve old published tables as historical source-specific records.

validation.inputs: Actual method B1 cached geometry, actual optimizer proposals and already evaluated response tensors
checks: base=.75 native/free projection identity for a common proposal
validation.budget: No toy, standalone pilot, synthetic suite, extra LM forward/backward/solve, or full-builder gradient audit. Account for CPU/reduction overhead.
validation.performed_now: Read-only source audit and SHA-verified historical scalar aggregation; no production implementation or experiment submission.
